description.value: Treed, family-oriented campground sitting directly on the Arrow Lakes shore near Burton, BC, with sandy beaches, a boat launch, and full modern washrooms with showers; reached by paved Highway 6 then a short run down Lakeview Park Road, open May 1–October 15.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was fully accessible and served as the primary evidence source. The 'Amenities and Activities' page and FAQ explicitly confirm showers, water hook-ups, a dish washing station, 30-amp electrical at 21 of 37 sites, a sani-dump, fire pits, and online reservations via letscamp.ca. The photo gallery section references a 'Gazebo,' confirming a covered shelter. OSM phone and address match the website's Contact Us page exactly.
concerns: OSM lists only the toll-free number (+1-844-265-4885); the website's Contact Us page also shows a local number (250-265-4885) not present in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operated lakeside campground on Highway 6 with showers, water, electrical hookups, and online reservations — a strong fit for touring cyclists on the Arrow Lakes corridor.

wow_evidence: showers, water hook-ups, a dish washing station, 30-amp electrical at 21 of 37 sites
